changelog: - **A shorter File menu.** The File menu lists names only, one per line: the Templates and the export formats are in two submenus, Templates ▸ and Export ▸, and Set the export author… sits next to Storage & privacy…. The description of the item you point at or move to is shown in full at the foot of the menu — on a touch screen, a press on a Template or an export format shows it with an Open or Export button. An item that is unavailable says why under its name.
